text: Some other features that we really, really wanted were elicitation and sampling.

text: Elicitation, if you haven't heard of it, is a way for you to ask the user a question, take that input and pass it back to your server.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: So, here we have, it's VS Code, and basically it's asking, you know, what's my name, and you're able to take that input and pass it back to the server.

text: Which is interesting on its own, but we thought in combination with sampling, which is unfortunately deprecated, but it's fine because you're able to work around it, but sampling is a way of having a server query the client's LLM from our server.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And kind of the canonical case was for small queries.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: We thought it would be really useful to combine elicitation and sampling into a single workflow.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: We talked about how Code Connect improves users' workflows quite a bit and kind of makes outputs a lot better.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: What we wanted to do was ask a user, can we map out your code base for code connections so that our MCP server can link them so that the output would be better and reduce the amount of contacts we send.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

speaker: SPEAKER_00
